title: Independent review of supplemental 2 Samuel territorial profiles
reviewerRole: independent reviewer; neither author nor editor of these supplemental drafts
readMethodJa: 各profile/evidenceの現物を再読し、固定WEBの初出・後続根拠を照合。Wikipediaは記事本文の該当節を開いて対象語・地理範囲を確認した。内容は座標や記事リンクの存在だけで承認せず、読者向け常時表示欄も評価した。

primaryWitnessChecks.text: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.
primaryWitnessChecks.basisJa: 2:9 enumerates the domain/regions over which Ish-bosheth was made king; it gives no boundaries and the term may also denote inhabitants.

primaryWitnessChecks.text: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand against the king, even against David. Just deliver him, and I will depart from the city.” The woman said to Joab, “Behold, his head will be thrown to you over the wall.”
primaryWitnessChecks.basisJa: Later text explicitly says a man was from Ephraim’s hill country.

firstAppearanceJa.summaryJa: 2サムエル記2:9では、イシュ・ボシェトの支配範囲を列挙する中に「エフライム」が現れます。この節だけでは、地理的な地域名とそこに住む人々のどちらを主に指すか、境界がどこかは確定できません。
firstAppearanceJa.subtitleJa: イシュ・ボシェトの支配地域として挙げられる地名
firstAppearanceJa.identityNoteJa: この節の列挙だけでは、「エフライム／ベニヤミン」が地理的範囲と住民集団のどちらを主に指すか判断できない。
firstAppearanceJa.historicalRoleJa: 2サムエル記2:9でイシュ・ボシェトの支配範囲の一つとして挙げられる地域名。
firstAppearanceJa.finding: The text warrants a region/territory candidate but does not resolve whether the name denotes place or inhabitants, nor precise boundaries; carefully qualified summary and null coordinate are appropriate.

facts.textJa: シェバは「エフライムの丘陵地の人」と表現される。

laterFactsAssessment.finding: The later verse is correctly kept behind its own knownBy gate; no later fact was found in the summary or historical role.

geographyAssessment.modernLocationJa: 本文だけでは境界や現代の地点を特定できません。地図上の一点で示す根拠もありません。
geographyAssessment.finding: Null coordinate is appropriate for an uncertain territorial expression without a defensible point. Do not infer a modern boundary from the tribe article.

wikipediaAssessment.bodyLocator: Article section “Tribal territory”, lines 159–165: the article describes a related tribal territory as a mountainous central-Canaan region; it does not establish the exact identity or boundary of the 2 Samuel expression.
wikipediaAssessment.independentRead: Opened current en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tribe_of_Ephraim, section “Tribal territory”, lines 158–166; it describes the tribal allotment as related territory and gives boundaries based on Joshua; it does not prove this 2SA phrase has identical boundaries.

entries.issueJa: locationNoteJa contains authoring/internal workflow language (“…区別できる箇所だけ採用…座標は設定しません”), not reader-facing geographic description.
entries.recommendedRepairJa: Replace the note with a reader-facing statement such as 「この名が指す地域の範囲は本文だけでは特定できません。」 Remove the editing choice and coordinate-setting explanation; preserve null coordinate and the later gated fact.

wikipediaAssessment.bodyLocator: 記事本文143–152行、特に147行で部族の相続地の境界を概説し、ヨシュア記18:11–28を参照。対象は部族であり、本稿の地域表現とは関連のみ。
